criteria.criterion: 1. Watch the results fill in during a scan: the scan is still running (Cancel enabled) and at least one top-level folder row already shows Bytes > 0 while others are not read yet
criteria.how: Real data in the shipped exe: hook watch on C:\Windows logged rows=126 folderBytes=7,402,256,255 notRead=48 running=True, and on C:\ProgramData rows=58 folderBytes=6,675,059,131 notRead=29 running=True. Core probe: the snapshot at 263 ms of a 15.6 s scan had 68 rows with bytes and 48 not read. L-001 passes too.

criteria.criterion: 2. Attribute a hardlink to a row: two names for one file in two different top-level folders
criteria.how: Real data: C:\Windows has 47,409 later hardlink names whose charged name is in another row. Every snapshot's rows add up to the totals, and every final row equals the store's rollup of its subtree (126/126), so each file's bytes sit only in its charged name's row (e.g. System32 11.2 GB, WinSxS 9.1 GB). TopLevelTests.AHardlinkAcrossTwoTopFolders... passes in the 170.

criteria.criterion: 3. Attribute an in-place size correction: the file is grown through the second name, so the FIRST name's earlier record is corrected in place after it was counted in another row
criteria.how: The exact shape is in TopLevelTests.AnInPlaceCorrectionOfAnEarlierNameIsCreditedToThatNamesRow, which passes. On real data (C:\Windows, 39,556 size-probed files) one Done row changed its bytes after Done. Only TopLevelTracker.Moved can do that. Rows still equalled the store rollup and every snapshot still added up.

criteria.criterion: 4. Show links in the top-level list: a top-level junction, a folder symlink and a file symlink
criteria.how: Real data: the 5 top-level junctions of C:\ProgramData are NotFollowed rows reading 'Desktop  (link, not followed) | 0 bytes (0 bytes on disk)'. Folder and file symlinks are covered only by TopLevelTests.TopLevelLinksAreNotFollowedRowsWithNothingCounted, which passes (links created for real under Developer Mode).

criteria.criterion: 5. Decide when a folder row is Done: a top-level folder holding a link folder (never pushed) plus ordinary subfolders, scanned to Completed
criteria.how: The exact shape is in TopLevelTests.AFolderRowHoldingLinkFoldersIsDoneWhenTheScanCompletes, which passes. On real data C:\ProgramData has 10 links, 5 of them below the top level. It completed with every row Done, Unreadable or NotFollowed, none left Reading.

criteria.criterion: 6. Show an unreadable folder: the top-level folder itself cannot be opened
criteria.how: Real data: 7 C:\Windows top-level folders (LiveKernelReports, ModemLogs, Prefetch, ServiceState, SystemTemp, Temp, WUModels) are Unreadable rows reading '(could not be opened)'. Their state matches the store's Unreadable flag, and the scan Completed. The report shows unreadable 7. The unit test passes.

criteria.criterion: 7. Show an unreadable folder deeper inside a readable top-level folder
criteria.how: Real data: the rows' unreadableBelow totals equal the store's flags, 45 on C:\Windows and 563 on C:\ProgramData. 'System32 … 20 folders inside could not be opened' is Done. No Done row's UnreadableBelow, Files or Folders changed after Done in any captured snapshot. The unit test passes.

criteria.criterion: 8. Cancel between folder listings (after the third folder)
criteria.how: The exact shape is in TopLevelTests.CancelBetweenListingsLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals, which passes. On real data, Cancel at 4 s on C:\Windows and hook Cancel on both real roots left a Final snapshot with no Reading row, equal to Totals, with StoppedPartway/NotRead rows.

criteria.criterion: 9. Cancel while a folder listing is in flight and SynchronousIoCancel interrupts it
criteria.how: Code contact only. TopLevelTests.CancelAtAnyCallLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals (before and during every guarded call, through the SynchronousIoCancel seam) passes in the 170. Where a real-data Cancel landed (between or inside a call) was not observable.

criteria.criterion: 10. End a scan with nothing to show: root never listed (already-cancelled token, unopenable root) or empty root
criteria.how: L-003 passes: empty root shows 0 rows and '<root> is empty.'; missing and relative roots have no topLevel and an empty header. TopLevelTests.NothingToShowIsNoSnapshotOrAnEmptyOne (already cancelled, missing root, file as root, empty root) passes.

criteria.criterion: 10 (sub-shape). End a scan with nothing to show when the scan faults after snapshots were shown
criteria.how: No runtime check is possible without a seam in the shipped exe. I only read the code: a failure passes null to ShowFinalTopLevel, which calls ClearTopLevel. The build declared the same gap.

criteria.criterion: 11. Read a snapshot mid-scan: a snapshot captured early is held while the scan keeps publishing
criteria.how: On real data the probe held all 58 C:\Windows snapshots and evaluated them after the scan. The early one still read 48 not read and 15.19 GB against the final 42.42 GB, and each still added up to its own totals. TopLevelTests.ASnapshotHeldEarlyNeverChangesWhileTheScanGoesOn passes.

criteria.criterion: 12. Refresh the list under load: thousands of top-level entries refreshed every tick, the final snapshot arriving right after a skipped tick
criteria.how: L-002 passes: 3,000 rows, containers=5, skipped=1, armed=True at Cancel, and the ending showed the final snapshot (topLevel equals core, final true). M-001 passes at 100,000 rows: refresh p95 67.9 ms, max 69.1, Input p95 6.8 ms, 5 containers.

criteria.criterion: 13. Write the report: the tree's top-level folders have recognizable names
criteria.how: L-001 passes (no Recognizable-Top name in the report). On real data 0 of the 184 C:\Windows and C:\ProgramData top-level names appear case-sensitively in the reports. topLevel holds counts only.

criteria.criterion: 14. Carry counting-rule figures through to rows: a compressed or sparse file (OnDisk < Bytes), or a path over 260 characters, under a top-level folder
criteria.how: Real data: C:\ProgramData has 26,673 files with onDisk<size and 9,013 entries with paths over 260 characters, and C:\Windows has 223 files with onDisk<size. Every final row equals the store's ChargedSize/ChargedOnDisk rollup, and the rows read e.g. 'Microsoft … 11.5 GB (6.0 GB on disk)'. In the Core suite only the sparse file in the cancel test covers this, with no long path in TopLevelTests.

obligations.evidence: L-001 passed again (rows=20 folderBytes=196608 notRead=17 running=True). The same watch against real C:\Windows and C:\ProgramData in the shipped exe also held.
CancelAtAnyCallLeavesAFinalSnapshotThatAddsUpToTheTotals (both theory rows) is in the 170/170 pass.
The unit test passes. On real data, 58 C:\Windows snapshots held to the end of the scan kept their early figures (48 not read, 15.19 GB).
L-002 passed again: 3,000 rows, containers=5, skipped=1, armed=True, and the final snapshot was shown.
L-001 passed. The real C:\Windows and C:\ProgramData reports contain none of their 184 top-level names (case-sensitive).
ScanResult.TopLevel was non-null, Final, and the same object as the last ScanProgress.TopLevel in every real-data run: completed, cancelled, and completed-before-cancel.

M-001 re-run at validate: refresh p95 67.9 ms, max 69.1 ms, Input p95 6.8 ms, 5 containers, 0 skipped. All under the limits, with a narrower refresh margin than the build measured. Another session's window cases were running at the same time.
Fitness op=check: 28 rules, every declared rule holds.

not_reached: Network pass: WindowCases -IncludeNetwork (N-001..N-004) and StalledShareTests (Network=SMB-LOOPBACK). They change this machine's SMB mappings and are the person's run, and this slice makes the last pass stale. Cancel and the results list on a stalled share are unmeasured.

The window clearing its list when the scan itself faults after rows were shown. The shipped exe has no way to make Scanner.Scan throw, so this was only read in code (ShowFinalTopLevel(null) goes to ClearTopLevel).

A whole big drive. The largest real scans were C:\Windows (346,873 entries) and C:\ProgramData (257,972). PS-002 speaks of a big drive, and nothing at millions of entries was run through the list. M-001 covers 100,000 rows on a synthetic flat tree.
Top-level folder and file symbolic links on real data. The real roots only had junctions, so symlinks rest on the unit test.
Cancel landing inside an in-flight listing on real data. Where a real Cancel landed was not observable; only the seam-driven unit test covers it.

The rendered window as a person sees it. Row text was produced through the app's own converter and list state was read through the hook, but no screenshot was taken, because it would capture the person's desktop.
The person's answer to the design's open question: whether a one-level list of the root's children closes PS-002's 'results fill in as it goes', or drill-down is expected in this slice.
Cold-cache behaviour. After the first C:\Windows scan (15.6 s) the later runs were warm (7-10 s).
